name: Adesh Sharma
player_statement:
A complete player, Adesh Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 58 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 39, with an average of 12.31 and a quick strike rate of 86.17. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 43 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 247.4 overs, taking 74 wickets at an economy rate of 7.36. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
